sourceTitle: My Friend Smith: A Story of School and City Life
description: "My Friend Smith: A Story of School and City Life" by Talbot Baines Reed is a school novel written in the late 19th century. The narrative revolves around young Freddy Batchelor, sent away to Stonebridge House—a school for troublesome and backward boys—by his uncle.
